title: 3.1.9 Lab: Terms and Conditions Loop
description: Write terms(), a parameterless function that asks the user to accept terms and conditions, then call it once per user in a loop. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Define terms
steps.instructions: Define a function called terms that takes no parameters. Inside it, log "Do you accept the terms and conditions?", then read a Y or N with prompt().

steps.title: Respond to the answer
steps.instructions: If the answer is "Y", log "Thank you for accepting." Otherwise, log "Have a good day."

steps.title: Ask how many users, then loop
steps.instructions: Read a number of users with Number(prompt(...)), then write a for loop that calls terms() once for each user.

requirements.title: terms defined, no parameters
requirements.description: Code defines a function named terms with an empty parameter list

requirements.title: reads an answer with prompt
requirements.description: terms() calls prompt() to read the user's answer

requirements.title: if/else on the answer
requirements.description: An if/else compares the answer to "Y" and logs a response either way

requirements.title: for loop calls terms()
requirements.description: A for loop calls terms() once per user
